label: Updated 8 PM ET
title: Today In Golf
summary: A 30-second briefing on today’s biggest golf stories.

items.headline: DeChambeau and Rahm’s PGA Tour Leverage
items.text: Bryson DeChambeau and Jon Rahm gained leverage as stars like Scottie Scheffler and Rory McIlroy skip the PGA Tour’s Charles Schwab Challenge, with DeChambeau considering a YouTube career and limited major play during PGA Tour negotiations.

items.headline: Soo Bin Joo Leads ShopRite LPGA
items.text: Soo Bin Joo thrived in strong winds to shoot 3-under 68, extending her ShopRite LPGA lead to four shots at 8-under 134 after 25 putts and only one bogey.

items.headline: Ex-LIV Leader Chacarra Targets PGA Tour
items.text: Eugenio Chacarra left LIV Golf citing lack of major and Ryder Cup chances, aiming to improve his mental game and wedge play to reach PGA Tour level and become "the best player in the world."
